messages:
amanda_sales: Heads-up — large POC with AcmeCorp. They asked for a 6‑month committed discount and a faster deal desk turnaround. Can we route this differently?

michael_dealdesk: Looping in here. What discount band are they asking for? We have to know if it hits exec approval.

amanda_sales: They want 35% off list for the first 6 months on a $120k commit. Sales ops flagged it as outside standard rate card.

michael_dealdesk: 35% is definitely special pricing. Need CPQ fields populated so the approval path goes to Deal Desk -> Sales Ops -> Head of Revenue (if >30%). Can you add the routing flags on the quote? @raj_engineer any blockers adding new CPQ picklists?

raj_engineer: Should be fine. We just need the exact field names and values. Also recommend we attach a short justification note so contract_bot can pick it up for SLA tracking.

amanda_sales: Suggested mapping: 
```
redwood_special_pricing_reason = "Strategic POC; potential enterprise
expansion"
redwood_commit_discount_pct = 35
redwood_commit_term_months = 6
redwood_approval_tier = "head_of_revenue_if_gt_30"
```
Would that work?

michael_dealdesk: Yep. Also add: redwood_required_response_sla = "24h" and redwood_escalation = "dealdesk@example.com" so we meet SLA metrics.

raj_engineer: I'll wire these as picklist/number fields. For routing, set workflow: if redwood_commit_discount_pct >= 30 then route to queue: dealdesk_escalations, notify: head_of_revenue. I can add a small automation snippet: 
```json
{"when": "discount_pct >= 30", "route_to": "dealdesk_escalations", "notify": ["michael_dealdesk", "head_of_revenue"]}
```

michael_dealdesk: Perfect. One ask — include a free-text field `redwood_special_terms` so legal can quickly scan for non-standard clauses. Also mark the quote with tag `POC-STRATEGIC` so reporting picks it up.

emma_cust_success: From CS side: confirm we can provide staging access and an SOW addendum for the POC. If legal wants sample SOW language I can drop it in.

amanda_sales: Please do, @emma_cust_success. We need the SOW snippet and a security checklist answer for Acme's procurement.

contract_bot: New quote created by amanda_sales. Status: draft. Automated check: missing fields — redwood_special_pricing_reason, redwood_required_response_sla.

michael_dealdesk: Thanks — @raj_engineer can you push the CPQ fields today? We want the deal desk to have the 24h SLA route so Sales Ops can respond within business day. If anything needs exec approval, flag it and I'll escalate.

raj_engineer: I'll add fields + workflow this afternoon and post the PR. ETA 5pm PT.

amanda_sales: Awesome. I'll prep the justification doc and ping legal + CS for the SOW snippet. :thumbsup:

michael_dealdesk: Great coordination. Once the fields exist we'll test with a dummy quote and confirm the routing/notifications.

emma_cust_success: I'll draft SOW language and the security answers by EOD tomorrow.

amanda_sales: Closing loop — will update this thread when legal confirms special terms. Thanks team! :rocket:
